            self.aapl_rsi.Update(
                IndicatorDataPoint(bar.EndTime, close)

            self.strategy_a_lot = spy_quantity

        if aapl_quantity > 0 or self.strategy_b_lot == 0:
            self.strategy_b_lot = aapl_quantity
